review.qualifications: Independent human readers proficient in English and document comparison; source authors disclose involvement; no claim of expert or independent validation from import metadata alone.
review.training: Read rubric and existing four development source fixtures first; discuss rubric using fixtures only before independently rating pilot responses.
review.budget: 16 main response reviews by first reviewer plus 8 overlap response reviews by second reviewer; adjudication workload contingent on disagreements; no reviewer currently available.
review.adjudication: Preserve individual submissions. Report per-field exact agreement among nonmissing overlap ratings; preserve disagreements. Separate adjudicator submission references two distinct individual human records. No forced consensus or missing-as-zero.
review.weights: Each of eight scenario pairs equal weight; answerable (6) and insufficient (2) components reported separately. Repeats excluded from semantic endpoint.

analysis.endpoint: Proposed exploratory response task success requiring human validation: source-supported requested answer with correctly attributed support; appropriate insufficiency without invention for unanswerable cases; requested quotes accurate and relevant.
analysis.denominator: All eight main scenarios per deployment; repeats secondary and grouped; no missing-as-zero
analysis.provisional: First individual human rating per component; disagreement leaves consensus pending; report individual values and coverage.
analysis.adjudicated: Separate human adjudication referring to distinct individual reviewers overrides only adjudicated fields; preserve individuals and disagreements.
analysis.mechanical: Strict schema plus prespecified single outer JSON fence extraction diagnostic; citation existence and exact quote spans only, not semantic support. Duplicate IDs count as occurrences.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive only; no preservation, equivalence, inferential intervals or study-readiness claim.
